resources.title: Cepeda, Vul, Rohrer, Wixted, Pashler (2008) Spacing Effects in Learning: A Temporal Ridgeline of Optimal Retention, Psychological Science 19(11)

resources.title: Claude API docs: Vision
resources.notes: JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP; 10 MB per image (API); 8000x8000 px max; >20 images per request => each image <=2000 px; 100 images/request for 200k-context models, 600 otherwise; 32 MB request cap; high-res tier (Claude 4.7+) long edge 2576 px / 4784 visual tokens; tokens = ceil(w/28)*ceil(h/28); images before text.

resources.title: Claude API docs: PDF support
resources.notes: 32 MB request; 600 pages (100 if context window <1M); no encrypted PDFs; each page = extracted text + page image; ~1,500-3,000 text tokens/page plus image tokens; base64, URL or Files API file_id.

resources.title: Tailscale pricing (Personal plan)
resources.notes: Personal: $0, non-commercial, up to 6 users, unlimited user devices, MagicDNS included.

resources.title: Tailscale Serve docs
resources.notes: Shares a local port over HTTPS to tailnet devices only; requires enabling HTTPS certificates. Page does not state plan availability.

resources.title: Fly.io pricing
resources.notes: No free tier for new orgs; trial 2 machine-hours or 7 days; shared-cpu-1x 256MB $2.19/mo; volumes $0.15/GB-mo; daily snapshots, 5-day retention by default, first 10 GB snapshot storage free; Managed Postgres from $38/mo.

resources.title: Render free instances
resources.notes: Free web service spins down after 15 min idle (~1 min cold start), 750 h/mo, no persistent disk; free Postgres 1 GB, expires after 30 days, no backups.

resources.title: Railway pricing
resources.notes: Trial $5 one-time credit (30 days); Free $0 with $1/mo credit, 0.5 GB RAM, 500 MB volume; Hobby $5/mo incl. $5 usage, 5 GB volume; volumes ~$0.15/GB-mo. Backups not stated on pricing page.

resources.title: Supabase pricing
resources.notes: Free: 500 MB DB, 1 GB file storage, 2 active projects, paused after 1 week inactivity, no automatic backups, 5 GB egress. Pro from $25/mo.

resources.title: Neon pricing
resources.notes: Free: 1 GB storage per project, 100 CU-hours/project/mo, scale-to-zero after 5 min, 6-hour history window (no instant restore), 5 GB egress.

resources.title: Cloudflare D1 pricing and limits
resources.notes: Workers Free: 5M rows read/day, 100k rows written/day, 5 GB total, 500 MB per DB, 10 DBs, Time Travel 7 days.

resources.title: Cloudflare blog: Python Workers are now generally available (2026-09-21)
resources.notes: FastAPI/Django/Flask supported; native-extension packages must be compiled to WebAssembly.
